title: Knesset passes laws barring UNRWA from operating in Israel
body:
On the night of Monday 28 October 2024, Israel's Knesset passed legislation by 92 votes to 10 that bars the United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA) from operating in Israel. The restriction was to take effect in 90 days. The legislation also designated UNRWA a terror organisation, blocked direct engagement between the Israeli government and the agency, and required the closure of its East Jerusalem office. It also restricted entry permits for foreign staff.

Israel alleged that more than 10 percent of UNRWA's Gaza staff had ties to terrorist factions, and that UNRWA-run schools incited hatred of Israel and glorified terror. UNRWA was established in 1949 and employs about 13,000 staff in Gaza alone. UNRWA Commissioner-General Philippe Lazzarini called the vote unprecedented and a violation of Israel's international obligations, said it could deprive over 650,000 Palestinian children of education, and called it collective punishment.

UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer expressed grave concern. US State Department spokesperson Matthew Miller said UNRWA had an irreplaceable role in Gaza and urged Israel to pause implementation. Egypt condemned the decision. Gaza's death toll was reported to exceed 43,000 by local health authorities.
